dvwinck-capybara-toolbox-ar-board-ar-boa.description: Starts a local approve/reject web panel (AR board) where the user judges many agent proposals one by one, then reads the decisions from disk. Use when the user wants to judge several options one at a time (ideas, templates, features, agent-architecture improvements, video themes, visual variations) with A/R keys and a comment per item, or wants to train an agent on their preferences. Triggers - /ar-board, /ar-board:ar-board, "ar board", "AR board", "approve/reject board", "let me approve or reject options one by one", "review N proposals", "painel de aprovação", "me dá 10 opções pra eu…

dvwinck-capybara-toolbox-housekeeping-do.description: Checks that what a repository's documents say actually exists - cited paths, links and anchors, parity between README.md and README.pt-BR.md, and versions and the plugin list against the manifests. Read-only, no network, exit code 0/1/2. Use when the user asks to check, audit or validate the documentation, for example "os docs estão certos?", "tem link quebrado?", "o README cita arquivo que não existe?", "o README em português está igual ao em inglês?", "doc-truth", "check the docs", "verify documentation paths and links", "do the READMEs match". Triggers - /doc-truth or…

dvwinck-capybara-toolbox-housekeeping-ha.description: Writes an end-of-session note so the next session can resume the work, with the git facts collected by the tool (branch, commits ahead of the base, modified files, stashes) and the citations checked before saving - whatever does not exist is marked "[not verified]" (pt-BR "[nao verificado]"). Use when the user asks to end the session leaving a handoff, to write a handover note, or to resume one, for example "faz o handoff", "deixa uma nota pra próxima sessão", "retome o handoff", "handoff", "write a handoff note", "resume the handoff", "end of session notes". Triggers - /handoff or…

dvwinck-capybara-toolbox-header-footer-h.description: Configures the reply header (a line such as "🕐 14:57 · main" at the top of Claude's first reply of each turn) and the footer (Claude Code's status line - session tokens, plan limits, clock, branch, model, context) from one config file - turn each one on or off, pick fields and their order, the time and date format, icon and separator, and diagnose why something does not show. Use when the user asks to change, turn on or off, or debug the header or the footer/status line, for example "put the branch in the header", "remove the clock from the footer", "show seconds", "why is the time not…

dvwinck-capybara-toolbox-publish-check-p.description: Read-only scan of a git repository (working tree and full history) for leaks before it goes public - Claude conversation links, paths from your machine (/Users/<name>), e-mail addresses and internal names. Use when the user is about to make something public - creating a public repository, opening a PR to a public repository or pushing to a public remote - or asks to check for leaks before publishing. Triggers - /publish-check or /publish-check:publish-check, "publish-check", "check this repo before I publish", "scan history for leaks", "is it safe to make this repo public", "checar antes de…

dvwinck-capybara-toolbox-ar-board-questi.description: Starts a local question form (question-board) where the user answers several independent agent questions on one screen, one key per question, with options and context in view, then reads the answers from disk. Use when the agent needs several independent answers before continuing (scope decisions, names, formats, limits) and the user would rather answer on a screen, or when there are 4 or more independent questions before starting. To judge proposals with approve/reject, use ar-board, not this skill. Triggers - /question-board, /ar-board:question-board, "grill me", "ask me the questions",…

dvwinck-capybara-toolbox-tidy-board-tidy.description: Cleans up git branches, worktrees and stashes through a local panel. Each candidate is a card showing the proof that it is already merged, only what the user approves (Delete; pt-BR Apagar) is deleted, and anything that exists in one place only gets a backup first. Use when the user asks to clean or prune branches, worktrees or stashes, for example "tem branch velha demais", "limpa os worktrees", "apaga as branches já mescladas", "tidy my branches", "prune merged branches", "clean up stale branches, worktrees or stashes". Triggers - /tidy-board or /tidy-board:tidy-board.

dvwinck-capybara-toolbox-housekeeping-to.description: Triages the TODO and FIXME comments of the code in a local panel - each comment becomes a card, oldest first (age from git blame), the user marks Resolve, Discard or Keep (pt-BR Resolver, Descartar, Manter), and the result is a read-only report; no source file is edited. Use when the user asks to sweep, list or triage TODOs and FIXMEs, for example "quais TODOs estão velhos?", "faz uma triagem dos FIXMEs", "limpa os TODOs do projeto", "todo-sweep", "triage the TODOs", "sweep FIXME comments", "which TODOs are oldest". Triggers - /todo-sweep or /housekeeping:todo-sweep.
